report.summary: Both UI failures are the same test bug: the page object clicks a test id that doesn't exist. tests/support/pages.py:44 uses get_by_test_id("add-books"), but the Add button in app/templates/books.html:9 is data-testid="add-book", so the click waits 5s and times out before any assertion runs. Fix the id in pages.py first, then rerun; the app is not at fault here.

causes.title: Page object uses non-existent test id 'add-books' for the Add button
causes.explanation: BooksPage.add() in tests/support/pages.py clicks get_by_test_id("add-books"). The books template defines the button as data-testid="add-book" (singular). Playwright waits for a matching element that never appears and raises TimeoutError at the click, so both tests that call add() fail before reaching their assertions. The app behaves correctly; the locator is a typo. Nothing else in the repo uses "add-books", and the other locators in the same method (title, author, year) match the template. Neither test got far enough to exercise the behavior under test, so the second test's expectations (error text 'Year must be between', input kept) are unverified by this run.
evidence: Failure call log: "waiting for get_by_test_id(\"add-books\")" then "Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded."
Both tests fail at tests\support\pages.py:44 via books.add(...) at tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:13 and :42 with identical stack traces and page url http://127.0.0.1:56598/books (the page loaded fine).
causes.suggested_fix: In tests/support/pages.py line 44, change get_by_test_id("add-books") to get_by_test_id("add-book"). Optionally, use get_by_role("button", name="Add book") or keep the test id, but make the id match the template. Then rerun tests/ui/test_books_ui.py; if test_future_year still fails, check its assertions against the real error message in app/main.py.
